arguments.query:
WITH w AS (
  SELECT time, pid, ppid, parent_process_name, parent_process_path, parent_command_line, childproc_name, process_name, command_line, object, event_record_id, source_stream,
         LAG(process_name) OVER (ORDER BY time, event_record_id) AS prev_process_name,
         LAG(childproc_name) OVER (ORDER BY time, event_record_id) AS prev_childproc_name
  FROM audit_logs
  WHERE process_name LIKE '%WINWORD.EXE%' AND command_line LIKE '%/Embedding%'
)
SELECT pid, ppid, parent_process_name, parent_process_path, parent_command_line, childproc_name, process_name, command_line, object, time, event_record_id, source_stream
FROM w
WHERE (prev_process_name IS NOT NULL OR prev_childproc_name IS NOT NULL)
  AND (process_name IS NOT prev_process_name OR childproc_name IS NOT prev_childproc_name)
ORDER BY time, event_record_id
LIMIT 1;
